name: Signature Fresh Henna Cone
description: Hand-rolled and filled with our signature triple-sifted Sojat henna paste. Prepared in small batches with premium essential oils for dark, long-lasting stains.
ritual: Apply to clean skin. Leave for 6-8 hours. Seal with lemon-sugar water.

name: Triple-Sifted Sojat Powder
description: Our finest professional-grade henna powder. Sourced directly from farms in Rajasthan, triple-sifted for an incredibly smooth paste consistency.
ritual: Mix with warm water and essential oils. Allow dye release for 12-24 hours.

name: Essential Bridal Kit
description: Everything an artist needs for a complete bridal application. Includes fresh cones, aftercare oil, and sealant spray.
ritual: Follow the included Artisan Guide for the ultimate bridal stain.

name: Botanical Hair Strengthening Mask
description: A potent blend of henna, amla, and brahmi to strengthen hair roots and add natural shine without intense coloring.
ritual: Mix into a paste with yogurt or water. Apply for 45 minutes once a week.
